first: Glad it worked out. Cleaning 420 rows of messy survey data is tedious work — you earned the break. Rest up, and if you hit anything weird when you're reviewing the flagged rows, just come back and we can sort it out.

turns.user:
I'm good, let's keep going. Nice — I finished the helper columns and flags. Can you:

1) Give an Apps Script that:
   - Reads the Raw sheet and the helper clean columns (G:P).
   - Produces/overwrites a Final sheet with one row per unique email; for rows with no email, treat them as unique unless name+timestamp dup flagged.
   - For duplicates (same email): keep the most recent timestamp but merge any empty fields from other copies (e.g., if latest has blank phone but an older copy has one, use the older value).
   - If any source row in the duplicate group had a REVIEW in column P or had differing answers (JoinedBefore, Phone, PreferredPark) mark the Final row’s Review column = "REVIEW (needs manual check)" and list which fields conflicted.
   - Include counts at top: total raw rows, rows kept, rows merged, rows sent to review.

2) Also paste a simple formula I can put in Q2 that builds a single cleaned summary cell (like "Name | Email | JoinedBefore | Phone | PreferredPark | Review") from the cleaned columns G:J and P so I can glance at rows in one column.

Keep the script and formula ready to paste — I’ll run them.

This is great — can you tweak the script a bit?

1) Add the original raw columns A:F (Timestamp, Name, Email, JoinedBefore, Phone, PreferredPark) for the primary row chosen for each final record (append as columns after the cleaned fields).  
2) Format the final Phone column as (XXX) XXX-XXXX when it has 10 digits; keep other values as-is.  
3) Make the summary at the top also include counts per canonical park (e.g., West Side: 42, North Park: 37) under the other totals.  
4) Keep the “Timestamp” in Final as the most recent raw Timestamp (not just the parsed timeClean) and write it as the original string from column A.

Paste the updated script ready to paste into Apps Script.

Nice — this looks almost perfect. A couple small tweaks before I run it:

1) Can you add a column "PhoneSource" in Final that says "primary" if the formatted phone came from the chosen primary row, or "merged" if it was filled from an older copy?  
2) Add a "NumSourceRows" numeric column (count of source rows merged) next to Source Rows.  
3) Remove the SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert at the end (I prefer no pop-ups when running).

Paste the updated script with those changes and I'll run it.

Looks great — one small tweak before I run it: can you make PhoneSource set to "primary" only when the chosen primary row had a non-empty, non-"REVIEW" phoneClean; otherwise set it to "merged" if the script fills it from an older row? Right now the logic might leave PhoneSource as "primary" when the primary phone was blank/REVIEW but later filled.

If you paste an updated script with that change I’ll run it and report back if anything odd shows up.

Nice — one more small tweak before I run it: can PhoneSource include the row number the phone actually came from (e.g., "primary (row 12)" or "merged (row 7)") instead of just "primary"/"merged"? If no usable phone, keep it blank. Paste the updated script and I’ll run.

turns.text:
Great, glad it all came together. You've got a solid pipeline now — raw data preserved, cleaned and deduplicated Final sheet, and a clear trail back to source rows when anything needs a second look.

If anything looks off once you start working through the review-flagged rows, or if you want to build anything on top of this (like a summary dashboard or an automated email to volunteers with bad phone numbers), just come back and we can keep going.
